input:
Channel: email
Subject: Payouts have been failing since Monday
Opened: 2026-09-29T08:12:00Z

Message: My payouts have been failing since Monday. I already re-entered my bank details twice. I have supplier invoices due this week.

Customer plan: growth
Open orders: ord_8121 (pending), ord_8144 (delivered)
Sensitive credentials never to request: password, security code, API key.

questions.name: needs_human
questions.instructions: Does this ticket need a human agent, rather than an automated reply? A manual payout retry, a refund, or anything only a person can decide counts as yes; a help article or the account data in the input answering it counts as no.

questions.name: any_queue_fits
questions.instructions: Does this ticket belong to one of the queues listed in the companion routing question: billing, technical, account, or other? Answer no when no listed queue describes the work this ticket needs, so a person has to decide where it goes.

questions.name: queue
questions.instructions: Which queue should own this ticket? Pick the closest queue; the companion predicate decides whether any queue actually fits.

choices.description: A last resort: the ticket is real work but no listed queue describes it.

questions.name: urgency
questions.instructions: How urgent is this ticket for the customer right now? Use the level that describes the customer's situation today, not the tone of the message.

levels.label: can_wait
levels.description: Can wait: no money or access is blocked this week.

levels.label: time_boxed
levels.description: Time-boxed: money or access is blocked within the next few days.

levels.label: blocking
levels.description: Blocking: the customer cannot operate and is losing money today.
